\vspace*{\fill}
{\small
\noindent\textbf{JKSSB Computer Awareness \textemdash\ MCQ Bank with Answer Keys}\\
First Edition, 2026. \textcopyright\ \BAuthor.

\medskip
\noindent Practice questions for the Computer Awareness component of JKSSB
recruitment examinations (Junior Assistant, Website Operator, Computer
Instructor/Operator and allied posts) and the SSC (CGL/CHSL/MTS/GD)
computer-knowledge syllabus.

\medskip
\noindent\textbf{Provenance (non-negotiable).} Authentic past-year questions are
labelled \texttt{[PYQ~\ldots]} with paper and key status; adaptations are labelled
\texttt{[PYQ-adapted~\ldots]} with source; generated questions are labelled
\texttt{[Original]}. Questions marked \textbf{(MSQ)} are multiple-select drills
labelled \texttt{[Original, MSQ drill]} and are never presented as an exam's own
format. Where a transcribed key was uncertain, that uncertainty is stated in the
rationale. Generated practice is never claimed to be an official JKSSB question.

\medskip
\noindent\textbf{Layout.} Within each unit, all lessons' questions come first;
the unit's \emph{Answer Key \& Rationales} follows, with a rationale for every
option. Questions are numbered per lesson (\textbf{Q1}, \textbf{Q2}, \ldots).

\medskip
\noindent\textbf{Companion volumes.} \emph{Detailed Notes} (full prose, unit-wise)
and the video course on \emph{Concepts That Click}.

\medskip
\noindent\href{\BWebURL}{\BWeb}
}

% ----------------------------- introduction -------------------------------
\markright{Welcome}
\phantomsection
\addcontentsline{toc}{chapter}{Welcome}

\fmHeading{Welcome}

\noindent\emph{Exam-focused Computer Awareness practice for JKSSB and SSC ---
fundamentals, hardware, office applications, networking, and security.}

\bigskip
Each lesson has a 30-question practice set. Unit answer keys identify the correct
option and explain the nearest-confusing distractor, so a miss teaches the trap,
not just the fact.

\vspace{0.6em}
\begin{fmbox}{How to use this book}
\fmbullet{Attempt first:}{Work a lesson's set under timed exam conditions before
checking any answer.}
\fmbullet{Mark, then read:}{Score your attempt, then read the unit's \emph{Answer
Key \& Rationales} for the ``why the other options are wrong'' reasoning.}
\fmbullet{Re-attempt the misses:}{Redo only the questions you missed; note the
trap pattern.}
\fmbullet{Reinforce:}{Pair each missed topic with the matching \emph{Detailed
Notes} lesson and the video.}
\end{fmbox}

\vspace{0.7em}
\begin{goldbox}{Provenance, at a glance}
Authentic past-year questions are labelled \texttt{[PYQ~\ldots]}; adaptations are
labelled \texttt{[PYQ-adapted~\ldots]}; generated drills are \texttt{[Original]} or
\texttt{[MSQ drill]}. Generated practice is never presented as a real exam question.
\end{goldbox}
